points.description: Defines classification as mapping data/inputs to discrete labels (categories/classes) and regression as mapping data to continuous values (real-valued outputs/function). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of classification or regression is correctly defined.

points.description: States how error differs: classification error is the number (count) of misclassifications, whereas regression error is the summed distance/difference between true and predicted values. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two error measures is correctly stated.
